name: cheap-7
description: SUPERSEDED by cheap-7-v2, and deliberately left failing chain-lint's self-review check, so it will not run - kept unmodified as the record of what the 2026-09-20 run actually used. Sonnet 5 holds the criteria, skeleton, builder, reviser and handoff seats AND a critic seat here, so it voted on its own draft under unanimous signoff; that is the defect cheap-7-v2 fixes. Do not add "selfReview": "allowed" to make this runnable again - use cheap-7-v2. Original description follows. Seven labs' small/cheap models, one seat each, all through one OpenRouter key: Anthropic Sonnet 5, OpenAI GPT-5 mini, Google Gemini 3.7 Flash, DeepSeek v3.2, Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash, Qwen 3.5 Plus, MiniMax M3. Blind proposals, debate, unanimous signoff. Seats get a 36000-token ceiling by default (each seat's own maxTokens says) and reasoning is left on: a debate is not squeezed to a short answer, and a reply cut off at the ceiling is retried once, then the seat is re-asked alone - it is never counted as agreement. The cap is a ceiling, not a price; only generated tokens are billed. Sonnet 5 builds and revises. For small questions where every model should still get a say; the frontier equivalent is reserved for questions worth its price. Prices are from src/pricing.json - price a real task with `npm run dry` before running.
